description: This file contains unit tests for a Go package 'orchestrator' that manages operations, including creation, retrieval, completion, waiting, and listing of operations within a concurrent environment. It tests the behavior of an in-memory operations map implementation, handling not found cases, timeouts, and synchronization.

methods.name: TestMapOMNewOperation
methods.description: Tests creation of a new operation, ensuring that the operation's name is non-empty and not marked as done upon creation.

methods.name: TestMapOMNewOperationNoNewUniqueUUIDsPanic
methods.description: Ensures that attempting to create multiple operations with the same UUID generator triggers a panic, verifying UUID uniqueness enforcement.

methods.name: TestMapOMGetOperation
methods.description: Tests retrieval of an existing operation by name and handling of non-existent operations with proper error types.

methods.name: TestMapOMCompleteOperation
methods.description: Verifies that completing an operation updates its status and handles attempts to complete non-existent operations with errors.

methods.name: TestMapOMWaitOperation
methods.description: Tests waiting for operation completion, including successful completion, timeout behavior, and handling of non-existent operations.

methods.name: TestMapOMGetOperationResult
methods.description: Checks retrieval of operation results for non-existent, incomplete, and completed operations, ensuring correct error handling and result retrieval.

methods.name: TestMapOMListRunningEmpty
methods.description: Verifies that listing running operations returns an empty list when no operations are in progress.

methods.name: TestMapOMListRunning
methods.description: Checks that listing running operations reflects the current state, properly listing active operations that are not completed.
